notes.text: Epicurus was an ancient Greek philosopher who founded the philosophical school of Epicureanism, which taught that management of one's desires, removal of unnecessary fears, friendship, and virtuous living led to a pleasant life and constant happiness, the highest good.
Epicurus is remembered as a philosopher connected with Greece.
Epicurus's recorded life dates place this profile around -341--269.
Epicurus is grouped with Philosophy, Ethics & Religion in the People Library.
Epicurus's profile connects a short Fact to a wider Greece historical setting.
